tradition.title: The tradition of elegance in the heart of Yucatán.
tradition.p1: At Ancona Jewelry, we understand that every piece tells a story. Since our founding in Mérida, we have dedicated ourselves to offering fine gold and silver craftsmanship.
tradition.p2: Located in iconic Colonia México, we are your local benchmark for trust, quality, and warm family service.
tradition.quote: "Our passion is creating symbols that last forever."
tradition.author: ANCONA FAMILY
tradition.historyStory: Founded by the Ancona family in the early 1990s in Colonia México, Mérida, our boutique was born with a mission to elevate fine jewelry craftsmanship.
tradition.historyParagraph2: Each design in our workshop combines classic goldsmith techniques with 3D precision modeling, guaranteeing unique heirloom pieces.
tradition.pillarsTitle: The Pillars of Our Jewelry House
historyPoints: Over 30 years celebrating life's most meaningful moments.
In-house workshop with certified master goldsmiths.
Ethically sourced materials: 14k & 18k Gold, 925 Silver, natural gemstones.

services.title: Specialties & Services
services.subtitle: Professional fine jewelry services by master jewelers in Colonia México.
services.boutiqueNote: Direct service at our boutique in Colonia México, Mérida.

list.title: Consultation
list.desc: Exclusive curation of gold and sterling silver jewelry.
list.waPrompt: Hello Ancona Jewelry, I would like personal advice for purchasing a piece of jewelry.

details.summary: Personalized 1-on-1 consultation to choose the ideal piece for anniversaries, weddings, or celebrations.
process: Personal consultation in boutique or online to match your taste & budget.
Complimentary size adjustment and luxury gift packaging.
details.timeframe: Immediate delivery or within 48 hours for resizing.
details.guarantee: Lifetime authenticity guarantee on gold and silver.

list.title: Layaway
list.desc: Flexible payment plans to secure your dream jewelry.
list.waPrompt: Hello Ancona Jewelry, I would like to inquire about the layaway terms.

details.summary: Lock in the price of your piece interest-free with flexible monthly payments.
process: Reserve any piece with a 20% down payment.
Secure vault storage until final payment.
details.timeframe: 30 to 180 day terms depending on the collection.

list.title: Repair
list.waPrompt: Hello Ancona Jewelry, I would like to request a quote for jewelry repair/restoration.

details.summary: Restoring broken rings, soldering chains, stone replacement, and prong tightening with precision technology.
process: Microscopic diagnosis by our master jeweler in Colonia México.
Laser welding, polishing, and stress testing.
details.timeframe: 2 to 5 business days depending on complexity.

list.title: Maintenance
list.desc: Professional maintenance for an impeccable shine.
list.waPrompt: Hello Ancona Jewelry, I would like to schedule a professional cleaning and polishing for my jewelry.

details.summary: Restore original shine via ultrasonic bath, mirror polishing, and rhodium plating.
process: Ultrasonic cavitation wash to remove embedded particles.
Rhodium protective bath for white gold and silver.
details.guarantee: Shine guaranteed & free prong safety check.

list.title: Bespoke
list.desc: Bespoke ring and jewelry design for unforgettable moments.
list.waPrompt: Hello Ancona Jewelry, I would like to get a quote for a custom bespoke jewelry piece.

details.summary: Custom creation of engagement rings and bespoke anniversary pieces modelled in 3D.
process: Initial sketch and hyperrealistic 3D digital render.
Selection of loose gemstones (diamonds, emeralds, sapphires).
Casting in fine metal, hand setting, and inner engraving.
details.timeframe: 10 to 15 business days after render approval.

closingCta.title: Looking for something truly special?
closingCta.subtitle: Visit our boutique in Mérida for personalized advice from expert jewelers.

footer.summary: Master craftsmanship in fine jewelry and local trust since 1990 in the heart of Mérida.
